newsitem.title: MEXICO: Avantel sees 15-20 pct share of Querertero market.
newsitem.headline: Avantel sees 15-20 pct share of Querertero market.

text.p: Mexican telephone company Avantel estimated it would obtain a share of at least 15 percent of the newly opened long-distance market in the city of Queretaro, a company source told Reuters on Tuesday.
"Avantel will take no part in the debate or in preliminary figures. Nonetheless, we do estimate that we will obtain between 15 and 20 percent of the Queretaro market in real terms," the source said.
The decades-old monopoly on long-distance services enjoyed by Telefonos de Mexico ended on January 1, and Queretaro was the first city to see new long-distance providers.
Avantel is a joint venture between MCI Communications Corp and the Banamex-Accival financial group.
